# 10 Best Clearscope Alternatives and Competitors in 2024

![Tom Winter](https://secure.gravatar.com/avatar/aa3b486402b5373030fb440224625e145ee725201cf4b9238dcb40be1e167f88?s=40&d=mm&r=g)[Tom Winter](https://seowind.io/author/seowind/ "Posts by Tom Winter")August 9, 2024

Clearscope has been a popular content optimization tool for writers and marketers to improve content and rankings. However, Clearscope may not be suitable for everyone. As a result, businesses, content writers, marketers, and agencies may be looking for Clearscope alternatives in 2024.

In this article, we will present the 10 best Clearscope alternatives and competitors that can help businesses with their SEO needs while being budget-friendly.

## 10 Best Clearscope Alternatives

### SEOwind

![seowind homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/07/seowind-homepage-ai-writing-1024x372.png)Source: [SEOwind](https://seowind.io/)

SEOwind is a great Clearscope alternative for creating content that ranks. Its content briefing generator provides you with all you need to create a comprehensive [content outline](https://seowind.io/content-outline-article-blog/).

#### Why should you pick SEOwind over Clearscope?

SEOwind is the best Clearscope alternative to support your content briefing workflow and AI content writing process.

Compared to Clearscope, SEOwind offers a suite of features that Clearscope lacks, related to [creating content briefs](https://seowind.io/content-brief/):

- creating outlines with one click based on SEO data,
- finding relevant questions for the target keyword from Google, Quora, and Reddit,
- discovering highly relevant keywords related to the topic you want to cover,
- taking advantage of powerful AI,
- collecting data on top-ranking pages (including keywords they are ranking for),
- easy creation of content outline by clicking the content you like.

On top of that, SEOwind is a great [AI Writer](https://seowind.io/ai-article-writer/). As content is based on comprehensive outlines, it gets to be more accurate, SEO-optimized, and user-friendly.

It’s true that both SEOwind and Clearscope help content teams, writers, and agencies do their job. However, where Clearscope was primarily built to grade content, SEOwind starts the process with the right content briefs. It’s the most important step for the content to rank, for new content, and for optimization.

##### SEOwind gives you the best start

In SEOwind content, briefs and outlines are at the heart of the content creation process. We simplify the process so that you have all you need in one place – no need to do tedious research across dozens of tabs.

While Clearscope has a content brief feature, it doesn’t offer an easy way of creating one. It requires a lot of copy-pasting around it. At SEOwind, we made everything available with a convenient click. SEOwind implemented AI to generate title tags, meta descriptions, and automated SEO briefs based on data to make the content briefing process more efficient.

```
To learn more go to How to create a content brief with SEOwind - Best Practices
```

##### SEOwind makes your content creation process data-driven

Content marketers and managers create content for a reason – to deliver value to their users and drive organic traffic. To do so, they create the best content. This is where SEOwind is very helpful – it takes the guesswork off the table and guides the creation process with data.

SEOwind gives in-depth keyword and topic research, covering:

1. Insights on top SERPs – their length, title tags, meta descriptions, and content length,
2. Keyword research based on top SERPs so that you know what keywords and topics to cover,
3. H1, H2, and H3s subheadings from the top ranking posts for that keyword to help you build your outline,
4. Questions sourced from Google PAAs, Quora, and Reddit, to help you uncover [related search](https://seowind.io/people-also-search-for/) terms your content can address,
5. [Keywords clustering](https://seowind.io/topic-clusters-seo-strategy/) to understand how to use keywords and terms, and how they can be grouped.

##### Streamline content brief creation with AI

We believe that AI can be a great assistant for content research and getting your content brief ready within a few clicks. SEOwind offers you the possibility of creating automated content outlines based on SERP data, not what GPT-3 thinks might be interesting to cover. It’s a great difference if you want your content to rank

#### ✅ SEOwind pros

- Long-form AI writing that creates articles and blog posts driving organic traffic,
- Great at its core – creating content briefs and outlines based on SEO data in minutes
- [Keyword clustering](https://seowind.io/keyword-clustering-seo/) within the brief
- Creating automated outlines that are SEO-driven

- Social listening capabilities – SEOwind crawls Reddit and Quora to identify questions on your topic

- One-click share of ready content briefs

### Content Harmony

![content harmony homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/content-harmony-1024x576.png)

Source: [Content Harmony](https://www.contentharmony.com/)

Content Harmony is another great alternative to Clearscope because it can help automate your content marketing workflow.

#### ✅ Content Harmony Pros

- Get detailed insights into the [search intent](https://seowind.io/user-search-intent-seo/) of any topic
- AI-driven topic modeling gives you keyword suggestions that you need to include in your content
- Check the outlines of your competitors in a single dashboard
- Understand the keyword difficulty with metrics like Link Difficulty, Content Difficulty, and Domain Difficulty
- Get [common questions](https://seowind.io/people-also-ask/) and suggestions that you need to cover in your content
- Allows you to identify visual content requirements

#### ❌ Content Harmony Cons

- Doesn’t provide any free trial
- The pricing for creating content briefs is expensive compared to other tools on this list.

#### ???? Content Harmony Pricing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/content-harmony-pricing-1024x576.png)Source: [Content Harmony Pricing Page](https://www.contentharmony.com/pricing/)

There are three pricing options available on Content Harmony.

- Standard plan costs $99/mo or $1,069/year and allows you to create 12 briefs/month.
- Pro plan costs $299/mo or $3,229.20/year and allows you to create 50 briefs/month.
- Enterprise plan starts from $1,000/month

#### ????  Content Harmony customer ratings

- G2: 4.9/5

Content teams and content marketing agencies looking for a tool to support their entire SEO content creation process and the content team.

### Dashword

![dashword homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/dashword-1024x576.png)Source: [Dashword](https://www.dashword.com/)

Dashword is another [content optimization](https://seowind.io/content-optimization-seo/) tool that offers similar features as Clearscope. It covers content discovery, optimization, and monitoring.

#### ✅ Dashword Pros

- It supports creating content briefs – analyzes the top results on Google and uses NLP to extract the most relevant and important terms for your topic.
- Content optimization – simple content grader at your disposal
- Content monitoring – review how your content performs
- Simple and easy-to-use interface
- One-click share of ready content briefs
- Affordable in comparison to Clearscope

#### ❌ Dashword Cons

- Difficult to figure out how to optimize content apart from using suggested keywords
- No keyword research tool
- No AI writing support

#### ???? Dashword Pricing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/dashword-pricing-1024x576.png)

Dashword offers two pricing options.

- Startup – Starts at $99/month and offers 20 content reports
- Enterprise – Starts at $699/month and offers 100+ content reports.

#### ????  Dashword customer ratings

Reviews not available on G2

#### ???? Dashword is best for

Mostly freelancers and small businesses. Businesses beginning their content strategy who want some clear guidance as to how to properly incorporate keywords and create competitive content.

### Frase

![frase homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/frase-1024x576.png)Source: [Frase](https://www.frase.io/)

Frase is another Clearscope alternative. It is an AI-powered content writing assistant that helps users research and produces content that is optimized for SEO.

#### ✅ Frase pros

- Provides top search results for better SEO-optimized content
- View what people are asking about your topic on popular Q&A sites like Reddit and Quora with the “questions” feature.
- See the top-ranking headlines for your topic
- Identifies the content gaps and helps fix them
- Access the topics feature showing the number of times your chosen topics are mentioned in each article.
- Provides a 5-day trial for only $1
- Money back guarantee

#### ❌ Frase cons

- Limited writing assistance
- The UI/UX is pretty complex
- Feels more like a research tool than an end-to-end content optimization tool

#### ???? Frase Pricing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/frase-pricing-1024x576.png)

Frase is one of the few tools to offer a money-back guarantee to its users. As for pricing, they have three different pricing tiers –

- Solo – start at $14.99/month ($12.66/month if paid yearly), offering writing and optimizing for 4 articles and generating 4,000 AI words
- Basic – Starts at $44.99/month ($38.25/month if paid yearly), offering writing and optimizing for 30 articles for a user and generating 4,000 AI words
- Team – Starts at $114.99/month ($97.75/month if paid yearly), offering unlimited articles for up to 3 users and generating 4,000 AI words
- Custom – Pricing and features as per specific needs

You can get unlimited AI-Generated Words, as well as other premium features for an additional $35/mo.

#### ????  Frase customer ratings

- G2: 4.9/5

#### ???? Frase is best for

Small businesses, bloggers, and freelancers, as well as agencies looking to get started with content optimization, speed up their [research process](https://seowind.io/keyword-research-tips/), and understand who’s ranking for their chosen keywords and why.

### GrowthBar

![growthbar homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/GrowthBar-1024x576.png)Source: [GrowthBar](https://www.growthbarseo.com/)

GrowthBar is the best Clearscope alternative for you if you’re looking for an AI-driven Content Generation tool and SEO tool all-in-one.

#### ✅ GrowthBar Pros

- Perform content generation, [keyword research](https://seowind.io/how-to-do-seo-keyword-research/), competitive analysis, and rank tracking all in one dashboard.
- Download content outlines into Google Docs and share with your team.
- Easy to use and affordable

#### ❌ GrowthBar Cons

- AI-powered outline for an article using GPT-3, which may be useful but is not based on data
- No tools for identifying content issues on already published website pages.

#### ???? GrowthBar Pricing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/GrowthBar-pricing-1024x576.png)

GrowthBar has three plans to choose from, so whether you’re a solo blogger or a large content agency, there’s a plan to suit you.

- Standard – $48/month ($29/month if paid yearly). Includes 25 AI content outlines, 500 AI paragraph generations, track 25 keywords across 1 site, and 2 user accounts.
- Pro – $99/month ($79/month if paid yearly). Includes 100 AI content outlines, 2000 AI paragraph generations, tracking 1,000 keywords across 3 sites, and 5 user accounts.
- Agency – $199/month ($129/month if paid yearly). Includes 300 AI content outlines, 5,000 AI paragraph generations, tracking 5,000 keywords across 25 sites, and 10 user accounts.

#### ????  GrowthBar customer ratings

- G2: 4.9/5

#### ???? GrowthBar is Best for

Marketers and bloggers who are looking to ramp up content creation and want to save time creating outlines.

### MarketMuse

![marketmuse homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/marketmuse-1024x576.png)Source: [MarketMuse](https://www.marketmuse.com/)

MarketMuse is an enterprise content strategy and intelligence platform. This AI-powered content tool assists users in researching, creating, and optimizing content faster.

#### ✅ MarketMuse Pros

- SERP analysis for creating content briefs, including headings and topics to include in the content.
- Suggests internal link-building opportunities
- Suggest better ways to rank your content, supports content optimization
- Content Inventory helps you manage your entire content library in one place.
- Stores content already on your site and suggest ways how to [rank better in search engines](https://seowind.io/organic-search-engine-rankings/), making it ideal for helping you perform content audits.
- Get updates on losing traffic

#### ❌ MarketMuse Cons

- No free trial. Given the high cost, taking the plunge can feel like a risk without a free trial
- Keyword Research Tool doesn’t offer search volume or competition metrics
- The user interface can be overwhelming
- Steep learning curve
- Complicated workflows & expensive pricing
- Unclear pricing

#### ???? MarketMuse Pricing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/marketmuse-pricing-1024x576.png)

There is a free plan available that can help you understand the capability of MarketMuse. Within it, you can generate 15 queries and 10 projects monthly. Apart from that, MarketMuse offers two pricing options. Here is how its pricing stacks up:

- Standard – Starts at 149$/month (1500$ annually) with 100 queries per month and unlimited projects access
- Premium – custom plan with unlimited queries and projects access

#### ????  MarketMuse customer ratings

- G2: 4.8/5

#### ???? MarketMuse is best for

Medium and large enterprises who are looking for an all-in-one solution.

### SEMrush Writing Assistant

![semrush homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/semrush-1024x576.png)Source: [Semrush](https://www.semrush.com/)

Semrush is one of the most well-known [SEO tools](https://seowind.io/seo-content-writing-tools/) available in the market, and they have created a writing assistant to help content creators and SEO editors alike.

#### ✅ SEMrush Writing Assistant Pros

- [Competitive analysis](https://seowind.io/competitive-analysis-seo/) thanks to SEMrush
- Comes free with the complete SEMrush package
- Install a WordPress plugin and use the text editor on Google Docs for seamless integration.
- Analyzes content in real-time, providing suggestions as you write.
- Track which keywords you need to include in your content
- Balances content optimization with readability

❌ SEMrush Writing Assistant Cons

- Not available as a standalone application
- It doesn’t support content brief creation in an easy way
- The user interface looks old and can feel clunky.

#### ???? SEMrush Writing Assistant Pricing:

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/semrush-pricing-1024x576.png)

SEMrush offers three paid plans:

- Pro – Starts at $119.95/month ($99.95/month if paid yearly) with 500 keywords and up to 5 projects
- Guru – Starts at $229.95/month ($191.62/month if paid yearly) with 1500 keywords and 15 projects
- Business – Starts at $449.95/month ($374.95/month if paid yearly) with 5000 keywords and 40 projects

### SurferSEO

![surfer homepage](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/surferSEO-1024x576.png)Source: [Surfer](https://surferseo.com/)

SurferSEO is a good Clearscope alternative. It is a one-stop solution for your on-page SEO content creation and optimization.

#### ✅ SurferSEO Pros

- Intuitive and easy to use
- The comprehensiveness of covering content creation workflow
- Strong [SEO audit capabilities](https://seowind.io/website-content-audit-tools/)
- Semantic analysis
- Gives internal link suggestions to help your content rank
- Robust technical SEO toolset
- Discover common missing backlinks opportunities so you can aim to include them and fully optimize past pieces of content.
- Has multiple necessary integrations like Google Docs and WordPress
- Integrates with Jasper, the AI copywriting software
- Money-back guarantee policy

#### ❌ SurferSEO Cons

- Weak content outline generation
- Keyword generation is not its strongest point
- Limited data provided for competitors’ content makes it difficult to identify competitors’ content gaps.
- Content outlines can seem a little simplistic, lacking in key data and information
- Can be too costly for some medium-sized projects

#### ???? SurferSEO Pricing

![](https://seowind.io/wp-content/uploads/2023/02/surferSEO-pricing-1024x576.png)

Surfer SEO Pricing starts at 59$. It offers the following pricing packages:

- BASIC – $59/month ($49/month if paid yearly) for auditing up to 20 pages and writing and optimizing 10 articles.
- PRO – $119/month ($99/month if paid yearly) for auditing up to 60 pages and writing and optimizing 30 articles. In addition, grow up to 5 websites on autopilot with Grow Flow.
- BUSINESS – $239/month ($199/month if paid yearly) for auditing 140 pages and writing and optimizing 70 articles. In addition, grow up to 10 websites on autopilot with Grow Flow.

There is also a custom price possibility for enterprises.

#### ????  SurferSEO customer ratings

- G2: 4.8/5

#### ???? SurferSEO is best for

SurferSEO can be particularly invaluable for outsourcing projects to freelance content writers and technical SEO specialists.

## Which Clearscope Alternative Is Right for Your Business?

Clearscope is just one of many tools on this list, and like any tool, it has its own set of advantages and disadvantages. Whether or not it’s the right choice for your specific needs or budget is something you’ll have to determine for yourself. Our suggestion is to select a tool that provides the features you require at a cost that is affordable to you.

Additionally, some tools provide a free or low-cost trial, which you should take advantage of.

If you’re in the market for an affordable content briefing and content optimization tool that can assist you in creating SEO content more quickly and adapting to your expanding needs, then you might want to consider checking out SEOwind.

Out of these, the cookies that are categorized as necessary are stored on your browser as they are essential for the working of basic functionalities of the website. We also use third-party cookies that help us analyze and understand how you use this website. These cookies will be stored in your browser only with your consent. You also have the option to opt-out of these cookies. But opting out of some of these cookies may affect your browsing experience.
